name: Laststance Skills
install: set -eu; missing=0; for t in node npm pnpm python3 bash jq rg ffmpeg git gh; do if command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '  ok   %-8s %s\n' "$t" "$($t --version 2>&1 | head -1)"; else printf '  MISS %-8s\n' "$t"; missing=1; fi; done; if [ "$missing" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Toolchain ready.'; else echo 'Missing required tools.'; exit 1; fi
